gloss: to sit in seiza; to sit formally on one's knees

definitions.gloss: to sit in seiza; to sit formally on one's knees
definitions.explanation: To sit in the traditional Japanese kneeling position with legs folded underneath, back straight, and hands resting on the thighs. The formal sitting posture used in tea ceremony, martial arts, and formal occasions.

examples.english: To sit in seiza on the tatami.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{正座|せいざ}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しびれた。
examples.english: My legs went numb because I was sitting in seiza for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正座|せいざ}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: In tea ceremony, sitting in seiza when receiving tea is the basic etiquette.

notes:
The standard formal sitting position in Japanese culture, where one kneels with the tops of the feet flat on the floor and sits back on the heels. It is expected in traditional settings such as tea ceremony, martial arts practice, and Buddhist rituals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sit in seiza (with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle)
- ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit in seiza position
- ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つらい: seiza is uncomfortable
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しびれる: legs go numb (from sitting in seiza)

CULTURAL NOTE:
While traditionally the expected sitting posture on tatami, younger generations of Japanese people are increasingly unaccustomed to sitting in seiza for extended periods. In modern casual settings, ⟦あぐら→あぐら：25420_agura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かく (sitting cross-legged) is often permitted, especially for men. Women may sit with legs to one side ({横座|よこずわ}り).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あぐら→あぐら：25420_agura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かく: to sit cross-legged — the casual alternative to ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧, considered less formal
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく: to kneel (on one or both knees) — different posture from ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧, which involves sitting back on the heels
